about: Transcribed by Arriba from NJ Transit's printed timetable No. 165, Westwood - New York, 'Issued 7/1/26' (file T0165 - 7/26). Not NJ Transit's data feed. Verify before relying: see docs/HANDOFF.md.

legend.T: Trip operates express between Rt. 46 and Teaneck Rd. in Ridgefield Park and New York via NJ Turnpike.
legend.P: Trip operates express between G.S. Parkway exit 165 in Paramus and New York.
legend.R: Trip operates express between Teaneck (Rt 4. at Margaret St.) and New York.
legend.RF: Trip operates express from New York to River Edge via Rt 4 then Oradell Ave. and Forest Ave. to Westwood.
legend.FP: Not defined separately in the printed legend; read as F (via Forest Avenue) plus P (Parkway express).

notes: Times are service-day clock times; 24:xx and 25:xx are after midnight and belong to the service day that began the evening before.
Printed timetable lists timepoints only, not every stop.

Westwood pickups to New York: because of routing changes, first pick-ups on local, T, R and P trips are stop #14025 Kinderkamack Rd. 100' North of Old Hook Rd. and stop #14026 Kinderkamack Rd. 160' North of Lotus Ave., served about 5 min. before the time scheduled on Broadway at Irvington St.
PM (P) Parkway Express trips stop at the Exit 165 Park/Ride lot only upon request at time of boarding.
